claims.claim: The committed v1 registry contains one brain-high-value-v1 profile with the four specified flows, eight ordered lenses and specified bounds. Parsing rejects duplicate YAML keys and unknown fields; profile digests use normalized strict JSON.

The pure module checks profile applicability against the supplied Decision Packet flow and derives a Stage-1 construct fingerprint from the packet fingerprint, profile ref, flow, return shape and normalized candidate.
Stage 2 checks exact packet, profile and construct lineage, ordered lens coverage, closed risk shapes and consistency between addressed risks and candidate changes.
Stage 2 fingerprints the reconciled candidate and full semantic material. Complete CLEAR closure yields CANDIDATE; any BLOCKER yields NO_DECISION with no handoff candidate.

The module uses caller-supplied material, enforces strict JSON, depth, byte and privacy limits, and performs no repository discovery, provider invocation, persistence or lifecycle mutation. Existing authority and authoring surfaces were not changed.
